integrity: Critical generator identities, equilibrium substitutions, and the boundary-quartic leading coefficient were replayed from the packaged exact-arithmetic checker. Literature comparisons are limited to material actually inspected.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures and does not classify unbounded trajectories.
The circle-crossing statement excludes stationary measures supported on the two equilibria; their convex mixtures lie entirely on the boundary circle.
No least-period lower bound is claimed.
The 2001 statistical Sprott-flow paper and 2004 analytical Sprott-flow paper were not available for complete full-text comparison.
Targeted searches cannot exclude differently phrased, non-digitized, or unindexed older statements.
title: Exact stationary circle and forced disk crossing in the generalized Sprott O flow
